summary: Verified (1) global rename Komutan→Kahraman across 8 languages and (2) new HeroTables component under mh_kahraman. HeroTables passes all functional checks: default states (star-1 & weapon-0 aria-pressed=true), correct data for all 5 star cards and 10 weapon transitions, no-deselect on same-click, 2-column card layout, EN/TR i18n titles/labels all render correctly. Found and FIXED multiple visible raw 'Komutan/Commander/Kommandeure/Commandants/Comandantes/Командиры' occurrences that were missed by the initial rename — after fix all 8 locales are CLEAN.

ui_bugs.issue: sb_komutanlar value was NOT renamed in tr/en/ru/de/fr/es (only ko/ar were). Rendered as raw 'KOMUTANLAR'/'COMMANDERS'/'КОМАНДИРЫ'/'KOMMANDEURE'/'COMMANDANTS'/'COMANDANTES'. FIXED to KAHRAMANLAR/HEROES/ГЕРОИ/HELDEN/HÉROS/HÉROES.
Still contained 'komutan' (Bu kategoride komutan yok). FIXED to 'Bu kategoride kahraman yok.'
Still referenced 'komutanlarla' / 'komutan' / 'komutanı'. FIXED to kahraman variants.

issues: The generic 'Bu kategoride kahraman yok.' empty-state message still renders BELOW the HeroTables component when mh_kahraman is selected. Likely because Commanders.jsx renders the empty commander-list fallback for every mh_* category. Minor UX issue — HeroTables displays its own data, so the trailing 'no heroes in this category' line is confusing. Consider suppressing the empty state for categories that have a bespoke component (mh_ekipman / mh_koleksiyon / mh_kahraman / mh_asker_egitim).

action_items: Consider hiding the generic empty-commanders message when mh_kahraman (and other mh_* bespoke component categories) are active.

Confirm the i18n text edits applied by testing agent are acceptable (KAHRAMANLAR / HEROES / ГЕРОИ / HELDEN / HÉROS / HÉROES for sb_komutanlar; Garnison-Helden for DE cat_garnizon; TR empty-state and KoF helper strings).
critical_code_review_comments: Rename spec asked for 'no occurrence of the raw word Commander/Commanders in visible UI' — but sb_komutanlar and DE cat_garnizon slipped through in 5 of 8 locales. Suggest adding a lightweight i18n lint (grep for /Komutan|Commander|Kommand|Comand|Командир|Commandant|사령관|قائد/ across the file) to CI to prevent regressions.
HeroTables.jsx: WEAPON_ROWS.parts values [10,25,25,45,45,65,65,85,85,100] and HERO_STAR_ROWS match the spec exactly. Component is small (~280 LOC), self-contained, has all data-testids. Good.

Number formatting via toLocaleString('tr-TR') hardcodes Turkish locale in HeroTables regardless of the selected UI language. Values under 1000 look identical but future >1000 values will use Turkish thousand separator in all languages. Minor.
Commanders.jsx renders the empty-heroes fallback for mh_kahraman even though HeroTables is present (see design_issues).
